_comment: Barcelona 2014-15 treble XI mapped to Q2 initiatives. 'player' = real name on shirt, 'number' = squad #. Reorder within position arrays to re-rank. 'tickets' link to tickets.json. 'profile' renders in Player Profiles section.
managerReport: Football is read before it is played. I stay in touch with Yoddhas in person, watch the WhatsApp bug-report channel, and keep one eye on Sentry and Firebase so production never surprises me.
I show up to product discussions early to align on scope and UX. I read backend flows for features I own so I can debug across the pitch, not just my half. The XI below is built on that habit.

GK.name: Sentry + Firebase Watch
GK.blurb: Last line of defence. Crash dashboards reviewed weekly; runtime health protected.
GK.profile: The last line. Eyes never leave the scoreboard — Sentry and Firebase reviewed weekly. The saves you don't see because they never reach the net.

DEF.name: Gitprint AI Stats
DEF.blurb: Surfaces AI tool usage across engineering. WIP.
DEF.profile: Overlapping fullback. Surfaces AI tool usage across engineering — bombs forward to support attack, still earning his stripes on the new system.

DEF.name: CodePush + JIRA Automation
DEF.blurb: Pipeline closes the dev↔QA handoff gap.
DEF.profile: The converted CB. Pipeline that closes the dev↔QA handoff gap — relentless, automated, never tires.

DEF.name: WhatsApp Bug Triage
DEF.blurb: Monitor the field-report group; convert chatter to issues before users hit production walls.
DEF.profile: Wins every aerial duel. Watches the WhatsApp field-report channel and clears danger before it reaches the box — chatter into tickets, tickets into fixes.

DEF.name: In-Person Yoddha Feedback
DEF.blurb: Walk the field, talk to users, bring back real complaints before they become tickets.
DEF.profile: Reads the game from the touchline. Walks the field, talks to Yoddhas, brings real complaints back to the dressing room before they become production tickets.

MID.name: Edit Lead Revamp
MID.blurb: Dynamic form deprecated. New component structure across the edit flow.
MID.profile: The deep-lying playmaker. Tore out the old dynamic form and rebuilt the midfield around a cleaner component structure — every pass crisp, every transition smooth.

MID.name: Yoddha Dashboard Optimisation
MID.blurb: Reduced app-open to first-API hit. Snappier opening minutes.
MID.profile: The metronome. Cut the time from kickoff (app open) to first pass (API hit). Sets the tempo for everything that follows.

MID.name: Lead Details Revamp
MID.blurb: PDD/Transaction upload + checkout form rebuilt without breaking listing or payout ETA.
MID.profile: The number 10's number 8. Rebuilt PDD/Transaction upload and the checkout form without breaking the listing or payout ETA — vision and precision in tight spaces.

FWD.name: Reusable Components Library
FWD.blurb: Shared components across screens. Less duplication, faster shipping.
FWD.profile: Wide left, cutting inside. Shared components across screens — fewer touches, faster shipping, dangerous in every attack.

FWD.name: Chatbot Client (the False 9)
FWD.blurb: Full chatbot integration on Saathi web + mobile. Drops into any flow.
FWD.profile: The False 9. Drops between the lines into any flow — Saathi web, Saathi mobile — wherever the play needs to break. Unpredictable by design.

FWD.name: Pre-commit Image Validation
FWD.blurb: Hooks block duplicate assets before commit. Internal portal flags lookalikes.
FWD.profile: Wide right, the press starter. Pre-commit hooks block duplicate assets before they reach the repo; an internal portal flags lookalikes. Never lets an opponent past untouched.
